what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Romania in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5672 Romanian asylum seekers in the United States, 72.0% of all asylum seekers from Romania.
Refugees from Romania, a separate group, live mostly in Canada, the United States, Germany and France.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Romania, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1301 asylum seekers and fell to a low in 2010.
It then rose, reaching its highest point, 6318, at the end of 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
